originality.rationale: Original relative to the inspected CPSR primary paper: its Proposition 2 requires all equal efforts, and Lemma 1 requires all opponents of a deviator to have a common effort. The present theorem removes both restrictions for three delegates in the all-signal-following regime. Its Example 2 instead uses pooling sincere votes under a non-neutral prior, which does not imply a counterexample here. Actual focused published-finding corpus queries, full source comparisons and own-claim searches found no equivalent; unindexed equivalence remains a risk.

Future versions of the primary paper may expand the asymmetric characterization

value.rationale: The primary motivating paper identifies asymmetry as potentially destructive of sincere incentives and proves a symmetric and one-unequal safe case. This finds the complete arbitrary heterogeneity robust region for a three-person delegated committee while each signal remains decision-relevant, and gives an exact signed payout margin and sharp countercontext via prior-induced pooling. The safe domain is economically natural and its result is not a direct restatement of the prior symmetric cases.
